arturo-liddi.title: Dr
arturo-liddi.short: In private practice as a dentist for over thirty years, specialising in endosseous implants and bone reconstruction.
arturo-liddi.bio: A graduate in Dentistry and Dental Prosthetics, who also holds a dental technician diploma. He has worked as a self-employed dentist for over thirty years, across the different specialities. He specialised in particular in endosseous implants and bone reconstruction, and also performs specific gum and periodontal procedures. He attended the university clinic for over fifteen years, in the implantology department, and has followed and continues to follow countless dentistry courses and conferences to keep his knowledge up to date.
education: Degree in Dentistry and Dental Prosthetics
Over 15 years at the university clinic, implantology department

giovanni-novi.title: Dr
giovanni-novi.short: In private practice as a dentist for over twenty-five years, and also a graduate in Medicine and Surgery.
giovanni-novi.bio: A graduate in Medicine and Surgery as well as in Dentistry and Dental Prosthetics. He has worked as a self-employed dentist for over twenty-five years. He attended the university dental department for about ten years and follows courses and conferences to keep his knowledge up to date.
education: Degree in Dentistry and Dental Prosthetics
About 10 years at the university dental department
